lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Y2Zn2O8 (reduced formula LiYZnO4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 74), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li and Y each adopt octahedral coordination with six O neighbors, while Zn is tetrahedrally coordinated by four O atoms; O centers have four geometric neighbors (one Li, two O, one Y). The same analysis reports corner-sharing between Li octahedra and Zn tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Li and Y octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
